metadata.title: UAE InSAR ground subsidence velocity — Phase 1 v0.1 seed dataset
metadata.data_origin: SEED dataset — single point digitised from peer-reviewed academic literature (Remah, UAE study). Full PS-InSAR processing pipeline NOT yet run; this file is a SCHEMA TEMPLATE for the SNAP-StaMPS output.
metadata.intended_use: Phase 1 v0.1 stub — proves the parcel-page integration end-to-end with one cited point. Replace with full PS-InSAR raster (~10-50k points across UAE bbox) once the pipeline runs on Жан's Getac X600 Server.
blocker_log: COMET-LiCS LiCSAR portal does NOT cover UAE — coverage limited to Alpine-Himalayan and Tibetan Plateau as of 2026-04-26 (verified via WebFetch on https://comet.nerc.ac.uk/comet-lics-portal-velocities/).
European Ground Motion Service (EGMS) does NOT cover UAE — explicitly Europe-only (excluded by name).

Sentinel-1 raw SLC data IS free + global via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/) but requires SNAP + StaMPS PS-InSAR processing pipeline (multi-hour, GB-scale download, Жан's X600 Server class compute).
ICEYE / Capella commercial SAR is Phase 2-3 budget item per `Y1_LAUNCH_PLAN_2026-04-25.md` deferral.
metadata.licence: CC-BY 4.0 (derivation from cited peer-reviewed open-access publication)
citations: ScienceDirect — Persistent scatterer interferometry, Remah, UAE — 40 mm/yr subsidence bowl, std deviation <2 mm/yr — https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0048969721010135

schema.point_id: stable string ID per persistent scatterer
schema.velocity_los_mm_yr: Line-of-sight velocity in mm/year; negative = subsidence, positive = uplift
schema.velocity_uncertainty_mm_yr: Standard deviation of the velocity estimate
schema.stability_class: derived: STABLE | CAUTION | WARNING | CRITICAL — see stability_zones.geojson for thresholds
schema.observation_period_start: ISO date — start of SAR time-series
schema.observation_period_end: ISO date — end of SAR time-series
schema.citation: URL or DOI for the source

properties.note: Centroid of documented Remah subsidence bowl. -40 mm/yr is the maximum rate reported in the paper; bowl extent is several km radius. Single seed point — the full PS-InSAR pipeline will produce ~thousands of points across this bowl alone.
Template point at Dubai Downtown. Awaits real data from SNAP-StaMPS pipeline.
